_doc: Closure & Authority Index — machine-readable navigation registry. CLAUDE.md §6.2b is the always-loaded human index; detailed proof stays in each surface's authoritative artifact. This file is NOT itself a closure proof: only the named authoritative_artifact establishes closure for the declared boundary. Index schema version is independent of any economic finding.

non_transitivity.rule: A CLOSED upstream subsystem does not make a downstream join, query surface, model, artifact, or decision path CLOSED. Only the named authoritative_artifact establishes closure for the declared boundary.
examples: CRT CLOSED does not close Gaussian, ZoneGate, RR, BitNet, or TradeNet lineage
CANONICAL_FEATURE_CODE_SURFACE CLOSED does not authorize RR/Zone economic reuse or model enablement
Geometry Gate-5 COMPLETE does not close Feature Query Surface or model lineages
Feature Query Surface authority does not close any producer, consumer, or model path

reopen_policy_default_closed.policy: A CLOSED surface may be reopened only when one of reopen_conditions fires; residual non-blockers listed in the authoritative artifact do not reopen closure.
conditions: governed code/config/artifact dependencies inside the declared boundary change
a closure invariant or mechanical check fails
new contradictory evidence invalidates the closure claim
the authoritative closure artifact defines an explicit revalidation condition that fires
